questions.question: Why did King Ahasuerus depose Queen Vashti?
options: She fled the palace in the middle of the night
She secretly plotted with his enemies against the throne
She mocked the king before the gathered nobles
She refused to come when he summoned her at the feast
questions.answer: She refused to come when he summoned her at the feast
